label: PF Backlog 507
title: E1: code-review agent production-risk checklist (business logic, security, injection, N+1/perf, edges; flag auth/payments/deletion; ignore style; critical blocks)
body:
## Problem / why
The code-review card focuses on scaffolding/mocks/tests and does not check production-incident classes.

## Acceptance criteria
The card's criteria include: business-logic correctness; security (authz/authn, input trust, injection:
SQL/command/template, secrets, unsafe deserialization); performance (N+1, unbounded loops/queries, missing
indexes); unhandled edges (null/empty/error/concurrency); a 'what breaks in production?' lens; ALWAYS flag
auth/payments/data-deletion as high severity; IGNORE style/formatting (defer to lint); critical => block
(NEEDS FIXES / not approved).

## Out of scope
Changing pr_gate mechanics.
